content: STAGE=scope-check | GOAL: confirm what the current round's SID pipeline looks like so the proposal names real tensors/dims. | READ: (to do) repo listing under results/research/121 and issue126. | OPEN: number of RQ levels, codebook size, latent dim, where Stage2 RQ-VAE trains, whether any Poincare code exists already. | REASON: the spec must be implementable without guessing.

STAGE=final-answer | GOAL: deliver one distinct in-scope mechanism (IDEA CURV-RESID-CONTRAST). | READ: round objective, scope contract, evidence 1-4, and the rejected plans of rounds 128/260/576 (successor Frechet codebook, per-level feedback curvature, radial behaviour ranking, MOEB branch curvature, TSG-SID, Lorentz successor-profile smoothing, behcone-prefix, succboost-geoshift). | OBSERVED: none of those places behaviour inside the residual-chain argmin with a transported codeword and a Poincare conformal factor; several rely on the tree premise or on fitting curvature, which evidence 1 and 2 invalidate. | REASONING: fix c=1 as an explicit gauge (radial scale from max||z||), take the behaviour contrast in the ratio form that evidence 3 says predicts recall (successor vs popularity-matched null, computed in tangent space), and use it as an anisotropic gain+unit direction inside the curved residual chain so level>=1 tokens absorb behaviour-predictable variation; geometry enters through parallel transport, exp_p accumulation and lambda(p)=2/(1-c||p||^2) in the same objective, so either switch changes the assigned tokens. | SWITCHES: behaviour-off = alpha=1,u=0 (still curved); geometry-off = c=0 (identity transport, lambda=1, additive chain); both-on = trained arm only. | OPEN: only the single frozen run decides whether code-space contrast becomes token predictability, i.e. Stage3 test_recall@10 > 0.065. | NOTE: the full answer block was submitted in the reply (record-length limit prevented verbatim duplication).
